Anonymous, Sir Gawain and the Green Knight, edited by S. O. Andrew.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/anonymous/sir-gawain-and-the-green-knight/s-o-andrew

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Anonymous, the author: no death year, because the work is anonymous.
- S. O. Andrew, the editor, annotator and writer of the introduction or preface, died 1952 (Wikidata Q30275494, P570 1952-01-01).

First publication of the text used: The colophon gives no publication year for this edition. The text was written between 1350 and 1400. (SE colophon: 'Sir Gawain and the Green Knight was written between 1350 and 1400.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the colophon gives no publication year for this edition, so the United States side rests on the edition's rights statement quoted below, which says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: Original: an anonymous work written between 1350 and 1400. An anonymous work written before 1800 is public domain in every country. Edition (English): the editor S. O. Andrew (died 1952) added words to the text. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less, so the edition is public domain in each on 1 January 2023. The country of first publication therefore makes no difference.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon of this edition (https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/anonymous/sir-gawain-and-the-green-knight/s-o-andrew): quoted above.
- Wikidata Q30275494 (S. O. Andrew), P570 1952-01-01.
